model: Sum-of-parts: toll-road owner-FCF DCF (engine route) plus Zheshang Securities stake at discounted market value plus associates

equity_bridge.item: Zheshang Securities stake: 46.46% effective look-through of market cap, less 25% holding-chain discount
equity_bridge.note: 601878.SH market cap Rmb40.63bn (price Rmb8.96 at 2026-10-09 close, Tencent qt.gtimg.cn; implied about 4.535bn shares; P/B 1.09x). 46.46% effective interest per H1 FY2026 interim line 131 (held via 73.625%-owned Shangsan Co) = 18.88bn. Less 25% for the two-tier holding chain, cash leakage to Shangsan and Zheshang minorities, and broker-cycle timing: H1 FY2026 commission income was +49% in a strong A-share tape. Cross-check: 46.46% of book at about 37.3bn Zheshang equity = 17.3bn. The bridge value of 14.15bn is about 0.82x look-through book and about 10x the stake's look-through earnings (about 1.3bn on FY2025 segment profit 2,815 x 46.46%). Its funding debt, customer funds and leases are inside this value and excluded from net_debt.

equity_bridge.item: Toll associates and JVs (Shengxin 50%, Zhijiang Communications 50%, HangNing 30%, YongTaiWen 15%, Shenjiahuhang ABS sub-tranche 20%)
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 segment note 7: interests in toll associates 2,531.1 + JVs 3,280.3 = 5,811 book; FY2025 share of profit 219.4 + 148.3 = 367.7. Valued at 12x earnings (0.76x book) because these are also finite-life concessions. Their income is excluded from projected EBITDA (matching-asset rule).

equity_bridge.item: Others segment: financial associates (Communications Investment Group Finance 20.08%, Yangtze United Financial Leasing 10.61%, Shanghai Rural Commercial Bank 4.96%, Transform & Upgrade FoF 24.99%, Carbon Environmental 11.67%), hotels, construction and PPP
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 Others segment net assets 10,317 (assets 10,788.1 less liabilities 470.8), of which associates 8,791.5; segment profit 742.9 (share of associates 766.9). Valued at about 9x earnings / 0.65x book, in line with listed PRC bank and lessor P/Bs. The SRCB slice alone is about 4.1bn at market (4.96% x Rmb8.55 x about 9.64bn shares). Construction service revenue is IFRIC 12 pass-through at nil margin and carries no separate value. This income is excluded from the toll flows.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case toll revenue 10-year path (FY2025-FY2035 CAGR about 0.4%). Group equity and revenue CAGRs are not a usable growth proxy here (see warning).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (16-19%) diverges >30% from revenue (9-10%) and EPS (-8% 3yr / +10% 5yr). Equity growth was inflated by the 2023 share issuance (4,343m to 5,993m shares) and by Zheshang Securities' own equity raises flowing through consolidated NCI-heavy books. Group revenue growth is driven by the broker, not the tolls: toll revenue fell 2.6% in FY2025 and 5.4% in H1 FY2026.
historical_growth.notes: Group FCF CAGRs are null on purpose. Consolidated FCF swings from -764m (FY2020) to 8,714m (FY2023) to 732m (FY2025) on the securities subsidiary's margin-loan, customer-fund and repo working capital, so a CAGR on it is meaningless. Toll-segment owner FCF is the valuation base: FY2025 about 3,774 attributable = EBIT 5,314 x 0.69 + D&A 3,410 - additions 3,303. SBC-zero, so house = street FCF. EPS 3yr is depressed by the FY2023 share issuance plus FY2024-25 toll erosion. EPS 5yr starts from the FY2020 COVID toll-free trough.

scenario_narratives.base: SHN reconstruction-and-expansion is approved under Zhejiang's 15th Five-Year Plan, and its concession is reset on the expanded road, the route PRC policy uses for capacity rebuilds. That costs the toll business 4-6bn/yr of capex over FY28-31 and two years of construction-traffic-control revenue loss. Diversion from new parallel roads (Suzhou-Taizhou phase II, Hangzhou-Shaoxing-Ningbo) persists, toll discounts are not reversed, and the Jinhua and Zhajiasu rebuilds reopen around 2028. Revenue is roughly flat over the decade. Zheshang Securities is held at a discounted market value: a mid-cycle broker after a strong FY26 tape. The Oceanking merger completes but is a modest per-share drag, not a value driver.
scenario_narratives.bull: The SHN expansion is co-funded with Communications Group or partners at lower group capex intensity, the reset concession carries a higher per-km toll on the widened road, and Zhoushan Bay Bridge and LongLiLiLong keep compounding on Ningbo-Zhoushan port freight and Zhejiang GDP at 5%+. Diversion stabilises after FY26. The A+H listing narrows the H-share discount; that is a price event, not modelled as value. Broker upside (Guodu integration, an active A-share market) is reflected only through the bridge, which is held flat across scenarios and may be understated in this case.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 15th-FYP rebuild of SHN slips or is assigned to the provincial parent. The Shanghai-Hangzhou and Hangzhou-Ningbo concessions revert to the grantor at nil consideration around end-2028 (Jiaxing Branch: 3 years remaining at FY2025 per the goodwill note), taking 47% of toll revenue. Shangsan follows around 2030-31 (5 years remaining). What is left (Zhoushan Bay Bridge, LongLiLiLong, Hanghui, Huihang, HuangQuNan, rebuilt Jinhua and Zhajiasu) runs off at -2% terminal on fixed-cost margin erosion, with more ETC and truck discounts mandated by the province. The concession cliff, not traffic, is the bear axis.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the parts that produce cash differently in the way each actually produces it. The toll roads are an unlevered concession annuity facing a concession cliff, so they are valued on owner FCF at an RMB WACC with explicit concession-reset or reversion scenarios. The broker is valued as a listed equity stake at a discount, never through a cash-flow statement dominated by customer funds. Associates are taken at earnings and book multiples. The H-share discount to A-share peers is real and persistent. This model does not assume it closes; it reports what the cash is worth to a patient owner at an 8% RMB rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Concession cliff: SHN (47% of toll revenue) and Shangsan have about 3 and 5 years left at FY2025. Reversion without a reset is the bear case.
SHN expansion capex could exceed the 4-6bn/yr base assumption if the group carries it alone. A 40-60bn RMB programme is plausible for a 248km widening.
Toll-segment net debt is estimated, not disclosed (segment cash). Each 1bn of error is about Rmb0.17/share.
Zheshang stake value is held constant across scenarios and is broker-cycle sensitive. A 30% A-share broker drawdown is about -Rmb0.7/share.
Oceanking share-swap merger: about 480m new A shares for a chemical business. Modest per-share dilution, not modelled.
Governance: provincial SOE parent, extensive connected transactions (construction, finance company deposits), and policy-directed toll discounts.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 5.695-8.16. FX Yahoo CNYHKD=X and HKDCNY=X at 2026-10-10. Zheshang Securities (601878.SH) and SRCB (601825.SH) market data from Tencent qt.gtimg.cn at the 2026-10-09 close.
data_sources.financials: FY2025 Annual Report (segment note 7 lines 8239-8343; operating rights note 20; goodwill note 21 line 9240; NCI note 49 lines 10996-11109; borrowings MD&A line 1297-1330); H1 FY2026 Interim Report (balance sheet lines 1195-1297; segment note 3 lines 1453-1514; toll table lines 200-278; Oceanking line 392); Metrics.csv FY2018-FY2025 and H1 periods.
data_sources.qualitative: 0576.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-11); FY2025 annual connected-transactions section on the Oceanking share swap (lines 3587-3618).

inputs.share_count_basis: 6,038.115m shares (H shares + domestic shares) at 2026-06-30, H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet share capital Rmb6,038,115k at Rmb1 par. FY2025 diluted EPS 0.8862 = basic; the euro convertible-bond derivative line is gone in H1 2026, so there is no residual dilution. Held flat. NOT included: about 480m new A shares to be issued for the Oceanking Development absorption-merger (445m Oceanking shares x 1.08 swap ratio, issue price Rmb13.50). CSRC registration came 2026-06-30, but the interim filing does not show completion. See notes.
inputs.sbc_source: None disclosed. The FY2025 annual report has no share-based payment expense and no share option or award scheme (provincial SOE). The only 'share-based payment' text is IFRS 3 boilerplate at line 6148. SBC-zero market: house and street coincide.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1721, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10. Cross-check: the inverse of Yahoo HKDCNY=X 0.8513 is 1.1747 (0.2% apart), which confirms the direction (1 RMB buys about 1.17 HKD). No A-share line exists yet for a parity check; it arrives with the Oceanking merger. Every flow and bridge item is in RMB millions. Unsuffixed per-share values are HKD so they compare with the H-share price.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo Finance chart API; 52-week range 5.695-8.16
inputs.wacc_rationale: 8.0%, built in RMB. Rf 1.8% (10y CGB) + beta 0.8 x 6.0% China ERP = 6.6%, plus 1.4pp for H-share liquidity and SOE-minority governance. That premium is a holder-level discount, not scenario risk: concession and traffic risk live in the scenario flows and are not repeated in the rate. Toll-level net debt is about zero (gross bank borrowings roughly matched by the toll segment's deposits; see net-debt note), so WACC is approximately the cost of equity. The same 8.0% applies to every scenario, so risk is charged once.
inputs.net_debt_note: Toll and parent level only. Securities-subsidiary funding (short-term financing notes, beneficial certificates, subordinated and corporate bonds issued by Zheshang, repos, placements, customer payables) sits inside the Zheshang stake value and is excluded here, as the deposits rule requires. total_debt 16,988 = H1 FY2026 'bank and other borrowings' (4,713.9 current + 12,274.5 non-current), assumed to be toll/parent (Zheshang funds through notes and bonds). Toll cash is not disclosed by segment. It is estimated from two independent reads that agree: (i) FY2025 toll-segment interest income of Rmb479.9m at roughly 2.3% implies about 20bn of deposits; (ii) toll segment assets of 54.26bn less operating rights 18.8bn, PPE/ROU/intangibles of about 5bn, associates and JVs 5.8bn and working assets of about 5bn leaves about 19bn of financial assets. Against toll interest expense of 546m (about 19.5bn of debt at 2.8%), that puts toll net cash at roughly +1.5-2bn at FY2025. The final dividend payable of 2.55bn at 2026-06-30 was paid in July, so net debt is set at +1.0bn, slightly conservative. ESTIMATE: segment cash is undisclosed.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), immaterial at toll level. Group lease liabilities of 628m are mostly Zheshang office leases and sit inside the stake value. Toll leases are negligible and not separately charged.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, inside the flows. cash_tax_rate_path is a combined tax-plus-NCI leakage driver. FY2025 toll effective tax was 23.3% (1,309.7 / 5,615.2 PBT). Toll NCI is about 10% of toll profit: group NCI profit 2,538.6 less Shangsan Co group's 2,166.3 (mostly Zheshang minorities) = 372.3, of which Linping Co 49.6 is hotels, plus about 26% of Shangsan Expressway's own profit. (1 - 0.233) x (1 - 0.10) = 0.69, so leakage is about 31%. Calibration: FY0 EBIT 5,314 x 0.69 = 3,667, against toll attributable profit ex associates and net interest of about 3,590 (2% tie). No NCI deduction in the bridge. The Zheshang stake is taken at the group's 46.46% effective look-through, which already nets the Shangsan and Zheshang minorities.
inputs.notes: MODEL: sum-of-parts, because the business straddles two routing rows. (1) Toll roads (46% of H1 FY2026 revenue): owner-FCF DCF through the engine on the TOLL SEGMENT ONLY. base_revenue is FY2025 toll revenue of 10,387.7 (segment note 7), not group revenue of 19,755. FY0 toll EBITDA is 8,724 (84.0%): segment profit 4,305.5 + tax 1,309.7 - share of associates and JVs 367.7 - interest income 479.9 + interest expense 545.9 + D&A 3,409.9. Projected margins start at 81% to strip miscellaneous other income. (2) Zheshang Securities (601878.SH, brokerage, 43% of revenue): a broker's OCF is customer-fund and margin-loan noise (H1 FY2026 group OCF -6.05bn), so it is NOT run through the FCF engine. It enters the equity bridge at the group's 46.46% effective look-through of market capitalisation, less a 25% holding-chain discount. (3) Associates and the 'Others' segment enter the bridge at earnings and book multiples. Group-level OCF/FCF and group total debt (71.6bn FY2025, 85.1bn H1 FY2026, mostly Zheshang notes and bonds) are deliberately NOT used. KEY STRUCTURAL ISSUE, CONCESSION RUNOFF: PRC toll concessions return to the grantor at nil consideration. The FY2025 goodwill note (line 9240) gives remaining operating rights of 3 years for the Jiaxing Branch (Shanghai-Hangzhou section of SHN, so about 2028) and 5 years for Shangsan (about 2030). Net operating rights of 18.8bn against 2.67bn/yr straight-line amortisation imply about 7 years weighted remaining life. Shanghai-Hangzhou-Ningbo is 47% of toll revenue. Its reconstruction-and-expansion is a 'priority candidate' under Zhejiang's 15th Five-Year Plan, which in PRC practice is how a concession is reset, at heavy capex. The scenarios are built around that cliff (see narratives), not around generic growth. FY2026 has no formal toll guidance. H1 FY2026 toll revenue was -5.4% YoY on diversion (Suzhou-Taizhou phase II from Jul-2025, Hangzhou-Shaoxing-Ningbo from Apr-2025), Jinhua-section traffic control from 31-Jul-2025, the all-ETC-truck 15% discount from 25-Apr-2025 and the end of government-paid tolls on 31-Dec-2025. NOT MODELLED: the Oceanking Development share-swap merger (about 480m new A shares issued at Rmb13.50 for a chlor-alkali business at about 6.2bn market value, 222x P/E, 3.4x P/B). It is about 8% dilution of share count in exchange for a non-toll asset that is fundamentally worth well under its swap value. Net effect on per-share IV is estimated at roughly -3% to -6% on completion, before any A-share re-rating, which is a market-multiple event and not intrinsic value. Buybacks: none. The company does not repurchase, and the flat count is a convention (SBC-zero). Dividends: 2,304m paid FY2025.

bear.tax_rationale: After SHN (100% parent-owned, no NCI) reverts, the NCI-bearing roads (Zhoushan Bay Bridge, Hanghui, Zhajiasu) are a larger share of what remains, so leakage rises to about 34%.

base.growth_rationale: FY26 -4% (H1 -5.4%, with easier H2 comps as the Jul-2025 diversion and Jinhua traffic control annualise). FY27-28 small recovery as the Jinhua and Zhajiasu rebuilds reopen and the Ningbo-Zhoushan parallel line feeds Zhoushan Bay Bridge. FY29-30 -3% each: traffic control on SHN during reconstruction, and the Shangsan concession end in about 2030 partly offset. FY31-34 rebound as expanded SHN opens on a reset concession.
base.capex_rationale: FY2025 toll additions were 3,303 (31.8%) with three projects in build. FY28-31 rise to 40-55% (about 4-6bn/yr) for the SHN reconstruction-and-expansion under the 15th FYP, assuming partner and provincial co-funding of the balance. Terminal 28% against 33% D&A, because future concession resets will need recurring rebuilds.
base.terminal_rationale: g 0% and cap 10x. Even a reset concession is finite (about 25-30 years); a 25-year annuity at 8% is about 10.7x.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 10x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% default): the filings never state the SHN concession expiry or a renewal mechanism, and the Jiaxing Branch's 3 remaining years puts a single-regulator decision on 47% of toll revenue inside the horizon. Base 50%: the 15th-FYP 'priority candidate' status and the precedent of the Jinhua and Zhajiasu rebuilds being booked as new operating rights make a reset the likelier path. Bull 20% (below the 35% default): it needs co-funding, a toll uplift and diversion stabilising, three independent things going right.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
